data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Maria, meaning 'rebellion' or 'bitter', but in Christianity, it is commonly associated with 'Mary', the mother of Jesus. Marney symbolizes the light of faith and devotion. The name Marney carries the meaning “Mary's light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marney usually hope their child will grow to embody mary's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marney total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
data.cultural_impact: Mary, the central figure of the Christian religion, is revered as the mother of Jesus, the Son of God, and her name has been passed down through generations. The name Marney is a nod to this rich and enduring history. It carries with it a deep sense of tradition and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: Marney symbolizes the light of faith and devotion. Mary's unwavering faith and commitment to God's plan for her life set an example for Christians to follow. The name Marney serves as a reminder to keep our faith strong and to trust in God's plan for our lives, even during difficult times. Marney's spiritual significance also reminds us to cherish the role of mothers in our lives and the sacrifices they make for their children.
